policy: Exclude the entire affected regular-trading session from all H4 intraday event construction and outcome measurement. Do not reconstruct, interpolate, forward-fill, or otherwise synthesize missing minute data.

exceptions.reason: Missing SPY SIP minute bars align with a documented consolidated-tape/CTA software incident. Underlying Alpaca SIP trades are also absent for the affected intervals, so same-provider reconstruction is not authorized.
